description: A clause body emits a BitstringRead for every field of its pattern (src/compiler2/body.rs:3778), including a byte only the guard needed and a _ :: binary nobody named. Each is a runtime call; a binary one allocates a view. Measured: walk reads its byte twice per step (one dead); JSON val/1 clause 7 builds 5 dead views per 172-byte line. Rule: the body reads a field only when the body uses its binding (the rule dispatch got in fz-sc8.183.2). Signal: a fixture walking with _ :: binary pins 0 allocations per step (1 today); fixture 01161 unchanged; pins fall or hold. Evidence and predictions: proposal page fz-sc8.183.5.html (workspace root); spike files in scratchpad b183-5 and b183-6.
title: A clause body reads only the bitstring fields it uses
